description.value: Anvil Centre is a four-storey public arts and culture complex in downtown New Westminster, branded on its own site as 'Downtown's Living Room.' It brings together a professional theatre, conference facilities, a new media and art-technology gallery, a community art gallery, the New Westminster Museum & Archives, and the Canadian Lacrosse Hall of Fame under one roof. Touring cyclists will find a dense concentration of BC cultural heritage and active year-round programming in a single accessible downtown building.
